flow postvisit.coding_review v1
title: Post-visit coding review
start: read_note
stage postvisit: After the visit
step read_note [Read] Read the note facts
  stage: After the visit
  does: Reads information from `records.note_facts`. It sends `case_ref`. It keeps `flagged` and `items`. If the call fails for a passing reason it tries again, up to 3 attempts in all.
  next: When it succeeds: go to Find coding opportunities
  onError: If it fails: go to Physician review
  onNotAvailable: If the connection is not available: go to Physician review
step find_opportunities [Decision] Find coding opportunities
  stage: After the visit
  does: Judges with the rule `postvisit.opportunities` using `flagged` and `items`. Every matching result is kept in `opportunities`.
  next: Then: go to Decide whether to ask the assistant
  onNoDecision: If the rule gives no result: go to Physician review
  onError: If the rule cannot be applied: go to Physician review
step assist_gate [Decision] Decide whether to ask the assistant
  stage: After the visit
  does: Judges with the rule `postvisit.assist_gate` using `assist_enabled` and `items`. The result field `use` says where the flow goes.
  on:no: If `use` is no: go to Physician review
  on:yes: If `use` is yes: go to Ask the assistant
  onNoDecision: If the rule gives no result: go to Physician review
  onError: If the rule cannot be applied: go to Physician review
step suggest [AI answer] Ask the assistant
  stage: After the visit
  does: Asks an AI model (`model-a`, prompt `coding-suggest` version 1) through `assist.suggest`. It sends `case_ref` and `opportunities`. It keeps `suggested_code` and `confidence`. If the call fails for a passing reason it tries again, up to 2 attempts in all. The rule `postvisit.suggestion_check` judges the answer next.
  next: When an answer fits: go to Check the suggestion
  onError: If it fails: go to Physician review
  onNotAvailable: If the connection is not available: go to Physician review
  onInvalid: If the answer does not fit the expected form: go to Physician review
  ai input: case_ref, opportunities
  ai input schema: {"properties":{"case":{"type":"string"},"opportunities":{"type":"array"}},"required":["case","opportunities"],"type":"object"}
  ai output schema: {"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"code":{"pattern":"^C-[0-9]{3}$","type":"string"},"confidence":{"type":"integer"}},"required":["code"],"type":"object"}
  ai fills: suggested_code, confidence
  ai judged by: postvisit.suggestion_check
  ai note: The model and the prompt are fixed in the document: `model-a`, prompt `coding-suggest` version 1.
  ai note: It gets 2 attempts to give an answer that fits the expected form.
  ai note: The rule `postvisit.suggestion_check` judges the answer next.
  ai note: When the answer never fits, the call fails or the AI is not available, the flow does not stop: it goes on at Physician review.
step check_suggestion [Decision] Check the suggestion
  stage: After the visit
  does: Judges with the rule `postvisit.suggestion_check` using `confidence`. It keeps `suggestion_usable`.
  next: Then: go to Physician review
  onNoDecision: If the rule gives no result: go to Physician review
  onError: If the rule cannot be applied: go to Physician review
step physician_review [Task for a person] Physician review
  stage: After the visit
  does: Gives a task to the queue Physician review. A person chooses Approved, Changed or Rejected. The person sees `case_ref`, `opportunities`, `suggested_code`, `confidence` and `suggestion_usable`. It keeps `final_code`.
  on:approved: If the person chooses Approved: go to Coding approved
  on:changed: If the person chooses Changed: go to Coding approved
  on:rejected: If the person chooses Rejected: go to Coding rejected
step approved [End] Coding approved
  stage: After the visit
  does: Ends the case with the result Coding approved.
step rejected [End] Coding rejected
  stage: After the visit
  does: Ends the case with the result Coding rejected.
